SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fy25.fiscal_week) AS week_of_period,
  fy25.fiscal_week,
  fy25.fiscal_week_start_date,
  fy25.fiscal_week_end_date,
  ROUND(fy25.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_2025_26,
  ROUND(fy24.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_2024_25,
  ROUND((fy25.net_sales - fy24.net_sales) / fy24.net_sales * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
) fy25
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
) fy24 ON fy25.fiscal_week = fy24.fiscal_week
ORDER BY fy25.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days_with_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  calendar_date,
  day_name,
  is_trading_day,
  is_public_holiday,
  holiday_name
FROM dim_date
WHERE (calendar_date >= '2025-06-16' AND calendar_date <= '2025-06-22')
   OR (calendar_date >= '2024-06-17' AND calendar_date <= '2024-06-23')
ORDER BY calendar_date

SELECT

  d.day_name,
  d.is_trading_day,
  d.holiday_name,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.sale_date IN ('2024-06-21', '2024-06-22', '2025-06-20', '2025-06-21')

-- Final answer query: Period 2 weekly sales comparison, this year vs last year
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fy25.fiscal_week) AS week_number,
  ROUND(fy25.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(fy24.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND((fy25.net_sales - fy24.net_sales) / fy24.net_sales * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_week
) fy25
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_week
) fy24 ON fy25.fiscal_week = fy24.fiscal_week
ORDER BY fy25.fiscal_week
